title: Celestial Choir of Souls
description: A surreal ethereal composition featuring numerous pale, rounded, organic forms resembling faces and heads floating in a bright white space. Many have simple eyes and open mouths as if singing, surrounded by glowing concentric circles, radiating light beams, floating flowers, and golden script-like symbols against a soft pastel background.
prompt: surreal ethereal painting of many pale rounded organic forms and floating heads with simple eyes and open singing mouths, arranged in a circular radiant pattern, glowing concentric rings of light at the center emitting bright beams, delicate flowers and golden floating script symbols drifting around them, soft pastel blue pink and white color palette with luminous atmosphere
